charts.title: Total Sales Trend by Order Date
charts.rationale: Tracking sales over time is essential to identify growth patterns and evaluate the overall health of the business as per the trend analysis.

charts.title: Profitability by Category and Customer Segment
charts.rationale: This chart identifies high-margin product categories and customer segments, directly supporting the objective to maximize overall profitability.

charts.title: Impact of Discounts on Net Profit
charts.rationale: Visualizing the relationship between discounts and profit helps optimize promotional strategies to ensure they do not erode net profit margins.

charts.title: Sales Performance by Region
charts.rationale: Comparing sales across regions identifies growth opportunities and informs supply chain and inventory allocation decisions.

charts.title: Sales Composition by Product and Category
charts.rationale: A treemap provides a clear view of how individual products contribute to category sales, aiding in inventory management and procurement decisions.

charts.title: Correlation Between Sales and Profit
charts.rationale: A heatmap of financial metrics reveals the strength of the relationship between sales volume and profitability, highlighting potential inefficiencies.

charts.title: Distribution of Order Profitability
charts.rationale: Analyzing the distribution of profit helps identify the frequency of loss-making versus high-profit orders, providing insight into operational risks.
